name: Dream Journey among Rivers and Mountains, no. 90
material: Handscroll; ink and color on paper
dimensions: Painting section: 24 x 341.5 cm (9 7/16 x 134 7/16 in.)
summary: Cliffs and waterfalls interspersed with trees and dotted vegetation are spread over this handscroll. Long paths wind their way through villages, beside cottages, shrines, and over bridges. In the past, Chinese literati officials liked to take a “dream journey” along mountains and rivers when viewing
